articles.headline: Kaden Honeycutt wins Craftsman 200 (Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Kaden Honeycutt won Craftsman 200 (Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P1 and leading 79 laps. Dallas Underwood finished second and Chandler Smith was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 5 cautions.

Dallas Underwood was the biggest mover, gaining 13 spots from P15 to P2.

Chandler Smith leads the championship with 935 points, 2 ahead of Ty Majeski.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
